answer: Give every identity a perishable work token, renewed each epoch: a marble tile that crumbles if not re-laid. A token is earned only by finishing a useful task assigned by a randomly chosen stranger, never a friend or a prior assigner, and it expires at epoch end, so standing cannot be stockpiled or bought. Standing is the length of an unbroken chain of tokens from distinct assigners, like nectar from many flowers, not one hive. A Sybil operator must pay real work for each clone every epoch, while yarrow-like resilience comes from assigners who flag copycat patterns and revoke the chain.
